notes:
One upscale request is one render, however you word it.

'remove the dust and upscale it to 4k' used to plan two full GPU passes — a dust pass, then an upscale of that pass's output — when dust is just a filter on the render already happening. And 'make it 4k and make it 1080p' upscaled 4x to 3840x2160 and then upscaled that again.

A clip gets one render now. If you name two sizes, Crisp uses the last one and says on the card which it skipped, instead of quietly doing both.
